This is the second of two passes of the same calls, 2026-10-16 20:05:49Z to 20:06:44Z, alternating call by call with Jev through api.hanzo.ai. The first pass, 20:04:43Z to 20:05:29Z, measured p50 277.4 ms, p95 425.6 ms (the answers' own latency_ms p50 146.6 ms). The server keeps the options it has encoded, so a call's time falls as the calls repeat: in this pass the answers' own latency_ms p50 fell from 126.9 ms over the first 20 calls to 26.6 over the last 20; served/server/n1 is their p50 over all 100.
